mapper.insert: INSERT INTO users ( email, password_hash, name, credit_score, max_monthly_payment, is_deleted, created_at, created_by ) VALUES ( #{email}, #{passwordHash}, #{name}, NULL, NULL, 'N', NOW(), NULL )
mapper.select: SELECT user_id AS userId, email, password_hash AS passwordHash, name, credit_score AS creditScore, max_monthly_payment AS maxMonthlyPayment, is_deleted AS isDeleted FROM users WHERE email = #{email} AND is_deleted = 'N'
